_doc: Filterable Explore attributes (ARCHITECTURE.md §6.2, §6.3, §6.10). Dropdown filters map straight to these; a natural-language query is parsed once into this same shape (Step 48). Photo-derived fields (Step 47) are written under profile.photo_attrs.* (per-upload snapshot, latest upload wins); the physical_attributes section mirrors to profile.physical_attrs.* (merged multi-image + stated record, stated wins). Explore prefers photo_attrs for the overlapping fields, falling back to physical_attrs only when it has no value.

photo_attributes.note: coarse apparent grouping only; never treated as ground truth

physical_attributes.note: coarse apparent grouping only; an unreliable surface impression, never ground truth
nullable; low confidence from photos alone — only with a scale cue
nullable; low confidence from photos alone — only with a scale cue
short free-text list of notable visible marks / accessories

notes: Photo attributes are observational and low-confidence; a conflict with a wiki self-report is a trust_flags signal (§6.3), not a correction.
ethnicity_apparent is stored for filtering parity but is coarse and self-acknowledged as unreliable.

physical_attributes is the richer, whole-profile companion to photo_attributes: one multi-image vision pass merged with the user's explicit self-report. The per-field record {value, source, confidence} lives at users/{uid}/physical_attributes/current; a flat value-only mirror lives on profile.physical_attrs.* for cheap Explore filtering. A stated value (structured profile field or wiki self-report) always wins over the photo read (source:"stated").
